issues.title: Rejecting 'MetaMask →' leaves the button stuck on 'Connecting…'
issues.summary: After rejecting the personal_sign request the page kept a disabled 'Connecting…' button, so the user can't try again without reloading.
stepsToReproduce: Reject the flow's main request in the wallet (error 4001).
issues.expected: Re-enable the button and show what happened.
issues.actual: The 'Connecting…' button is still disabled 2s later.
